title: PlusOne landing: choose a composition
question: Three comps in the YourDay + Loverly world. Pick the one to build, or tell me what to combine or change.

options.label: A · The app is the hero
options.thesis: Centered serif promise, then the real app working: vendors, quotes, budget and a new-reply notification.
options.viewport: Nav, centered headline with Start planning and Take the 1-minute tour, wide app preview below on a blush band.
options.risk: Closest to YourDay's structure; sign-up sits one click away rather than on the page.

options.label: B · Editorial split
options.thesis: Loverly-style romance: sign-up on the left, a large wedding photograph on the right with a vendor reply card landing on it.
options.viewport: Headline and inline sign-up with a tour link on the left, full-height reception photo with an overlapping quote reply on the right.
options.risk: The photo carries the mood, so the emailing mechanism is shown only by one small card.

options.label: C · The tour is the hero
options.thesis: Minimal: five calm steps from wedding date to booked vendor, with step 3's email draft opened beneath.
options.viewport: Headline, a five-step tour line with the active step lifted, an email draft with Approve & send, then Start planning and Play the tour.
options.risk: Explains the flow best but shows less of the app itself; the 'No card needed' caption would need to stay true.
